'''Patrick Toussaint Mas''' (born 10 April 1959) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1980 Winter Olympics|three events]] at the [[1980 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/to/patrick-toussaint-1.html |title=Patrick Toussaint |access-date=19 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418073900/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/to/patrick-toussaint-1.html |archive-date=18 April 2020 |quote=Full name: Patrick Toussaint Mas}}</ref>
